text:
maria: Quick question — for the automatic fallback UX, can we add a 'sensitivity' slider instead of the current on/off? the boolean feels too blunt when mapping errors -> degrade modes.

alex: I like the idea. main caveat: audit logs could balloon if we record every decision at fine granularity.

jordan: what if the slider only changes the decision threshold and we emit a compact breadcrumb for each fallback (reason code + small score) rather than full trace unless requested?

sam: compact breadcrumbs sound promising. what's the proposed shape? tiny JSON ok in logs?

jordan: prototype snippet: ```json
{"reason":"latency_spike","score":0.82,"fallback":"small-quantized","audit_id":"a1b2c3"}
```

alex: +1 to compact. UX should show estimated % traffic that would hit fallback at each slider position so operators understand impact.

maria: Agreed — slider labels: conservative / default / aggressive and a small preview bar showing simulated traffic impact (computed from recent telemetry).

sam: Need per-route override too. some routes (billing) should be less aggressive by default.

ops-bot: deploybot: dry-run for rollout-sensitivity v1 scheduled on staging at 03:00 UTC :gear:

alex: Storage/ingest question: store full decision traces only when breadcrumb.score within a narrow window (eg 0.4-0.6) or when operator clicks 'investigate' from console. everything else stays as 200B breadcrumb.
jordan: nice — heuristics to keep hot-path traces limited. also add audit_id to breadcrumb so we can link to full trace if it exists.

maria: retention proposal: full traces 30d, breadcrumbs 1y (configurable per-org). thoughts?

sam: 1y crumbs reasonable if compact. also expose an export for compliance teams that can expand breadcrumbs into sample traces on demand.

alex: UX microcopy: "Sensitivity adjusts how quickly the system degrades to safer model variants on errors or latency. Preview shows expected rate of degraded requests based on last 24h." short and clear.

maria: Action items: 1) @alex run storage+cost calc for 256B breadcrumbs at projected QPS (and cost delta for keeping 30d vs 1y). 2) @sam mock slider + preview bar (Figma). 3) @jordan draft compact breadcrumb schema + audit_id linking. 4) I'll write console copy and policy defaults.

jordan: I'll post the schema PR draft later today.

alex: I'll run a quick burst sim and post numbers here.

maria: Perfect. if we can get a small dry-run in staging from deploybot, we can collect real preview numbers. thanks all :+1:
